page.content:
Subiay was a Fremen of Sietch Tabr. Alia Atreides had watched her giving birth to her son who reminded her of the son of Mitha, a woman from her Other Memory who had lived before the Parting.

Who is Subiay?

Subiay was a Fremen of Sietch Tabr. Alia Atreides had watched her giving birth to her son who reminded her of the son of Mitha, a woman from her Other Memory who had lived before the Parting.
